title: docs(skills): platform manifest example is type-checked; plugin examples compile against the kernel Plugin contract
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xCnkH8ikcdEEh14bVjmhM89)_

Part of #31112

Slice 9 of the card: item 4, the objectstack-platform example blocks that slice 6 left (SKILL.md, `references/bootstrap.md`, `references/operations.md`, `references/plugin-development.md`).

## 维护者速读

**需要你做的:** 本 PR 为 **Tier H**(`skills/**`,`check-governed-merges.mjs --test` 实测 GOVERNED),保持 draft;当前 head 还欠契约审查(contract review),由 skills 席位按 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 做记录审查,通过后席位再请你批准。
改了什么:platform SKILL.md 的 manifest 示例包进 `defineStack({ manifest })` 并加 `<!-- os:check -->`,现在由 `check:skill-examples` 编译(343 → 344)。
修了一行错误示例:`plugin-development.md` 的完整插件示例写 `type: 'plugin'`,不在 `PluginType` 封闭集合里,`kernel.use()` 启动时会拒绝;改为 `'standard'`。
Plugin Interface 概览块的 import 与其声明冲突,并缺 `PluginType`,一并修正。
其余 21 块依赖 `@objectstack/core`、运行时包或项目本地模块,或是片段,检查器只解析 `@objectstack/spec`,所以不加标记;另有 2 块加包装后能编译,但 token 行没有余量,按席位裁定不加标记。
四个 token 行都没有超过上限,没有改动任何上限。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` § Manifest Reference:** the bare `manifest: { … }` fragment is now `defineStack({ manifest: { … } })` with its import, under `<!-- os:check -->`. The cost is paid inside the block. The comment padding is gone. The `engines` comment "Metadata-protocol major this app targets" is cut, because the `manifest.engines.protocol` paragraph directly below states the same thing. "Optional description" is shortened to "Optional".
- **`references/plugin-development.md` § Complete Example (L191):** `type: 'plugin'` → `type: 'standard'`. Against core's `.d.ts` this is TS2322: `PluginType` is the closed set `'standard'` plus the core plugin types, and `'plugin'` is not in it. `kernel.use()` runs `PluginSchema` over every plugin object and raises `PLUGIN_CONTRACT_VIOLATION` for this value, so the copied plugin would not boot.
- **`references/plugin-development.md` § Plugin Interface (L71):** the block imported `Plugin` and then declared `interface Plugin` (TS2440), and used `PluginType` without importing it (TS2304). The import is now `{ PluginContext, PluginType }`. The interface shape is unchanged.

### Cut list, with surviving homes

| Cut | Surviving home |
|:--|:--|
| SKILL.md manifest block: `// Metadata-protocol major this app targets` on `engines` | the `**manifest.engines.protocol:**` paragraph directly below the block ("the metadata-protocol major the app is authored against") |
| SKILL.md manifest block: `// Optional description` → `// Optional` | same line: the key is `description`, the comment keeps "Optional" |
| SKILL.md manifest block: alignment spaces before the comments | none needed: whitespace |

No rule is cut. No line changed here is pinned: `packages/*/src/**/*.test.ts` and `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/*.json` were grepped for the changed lines (`config-plugins-ops.json` case 1 expects `engines: { protocol: '^18' }`, which stays). § Manifest Reference is not a registered exhaustive section in `check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs`.

### Diffs

```diff
@@ skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md · § Manifest Reference
+<!-- os:check -->
 ```typescript
-manifest: {
-  id: 'com.example.crm',        // Reverse domain unique ID
-  version: '1.0.0',             // Semver
-  type: 'app',                  // app | plugin | driver | module | ...
-  name: 'Acme CRM',             // Human-readable display name
-  description: 'CRM system',    // Optional description
-  engines: { protocol: '^18' }, // Metadata-protocol major this app targets
-}
+import { defineStack } from '@objectstack/spec';
+export default defineStack({ manifest: {
+  id: 'com.example.crm', // Reverse domain unique ID
+  version: '1.0.0', // Semver
+  type: 'app', // app | plugin | driver | module | ...
+  name: 'Acme CRM', // Human-readable display name
+  description: 'CRM system', // Optional
+  engines: { protocol: '^18' },
+} });
 ```
@@ skills/objectstack-platform/references/plugin-development.md · § Plugin Interface
-import type { Plugin, PluginContext } from '@objectstack/core';
+import type { PluginContext, PluginType } from '@objectstack/core';
@@ skills/objectstack-platform/references/plugin-development.md · § Complete Example
   version: '1.0.0',
-  type: 'plugin',
+  type: 'standard',
```

### Marks, before → after (column-0 `ts`/`typescript` fences)

| File | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| SKILL.md | 0/4 | 1/4 |
| references/bootstrap.md | 1/6 | 1/6 |
| references/operations.md | 0/1 | 0/1 |
| references/plugin-development.md | 0/12 | 0/12 |
| **platform total (with slice 6's 40)** | **1/63** | **2/63** |

### Compiles with a wrapper, left unmarked (seat ruling: no ceiling raise, no surface widening)

- SKILL.md § Demo accounts, the `demoStaff` block: wrapped in `defineStack({ demoStaff: [...] })` it compiles (trial run: 346 green). Left unmarked: **23 tokens over the row** (6034 / 6011).
- `references/operations.md` § Mobile push, the `push` block: wrapped with an import, `declare const teamId, keyId, projectId` and `defineStack({ push })` it compiles (same trial run). Left unmarked: **35 tokens over the row** (3429 / 3394).

A later slice can mark either one if it finds a restatement cut in the same file to pay for it.

### Unmarkable (the record for this slice; no per-file note, per slice 6's ruling)

Each block was written alone to its own build dir and type-checked against the built `.d.ts` of `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/hono`, `@objectstack/metadata` and `@objectstack/driver-memory`. Fragments got a probe-only `declare const ctx: PluginContext` / `kernel: ObjectKernel` wrapper, and project-local imports got a stub. Every block below type-checks that way. The only diagnostics were in the two plugin-development blocks fixed above.

- SKILL.md L239 (`@objectstack/hono`), L350 (`onEnable`: calls an app-local helper).
- bootstrap.md L38 (two `objects` keys in one literal, showing the array and map forms side by side on purpose), L57, L164, L169 (import project-local modules such as `./src/objects`), L102 (`@objectstack/runtime`).
- plugin-development.md: all 12 blocks need `@objectstack/core` (`ObjectKernel`, `LiteKernel`, `Plugin`, `PluginContext`) or a runtime package. `check:skill-examples` resolves `@objectstack/spec` only.

## Why

Card #31112 item 4 puts the published examples under the opt-in check that #22059 ruling B chose. Slice 6 (PR #31879) found platform's rules and hooks files unmarkable and said what was left: these 23 blocks, to be probed against core first. That probe also found the one example a reader copies that would not boot.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` :: exit 0, 344 prose examples across 3 surfaces (343 on `main`).
- Reverse check: a planted `bogusKey: 1` in the manifest block → exit 1, `TS2353` at `SKILL.md:111`. Restored, and `git diff` is clean.
- Token ratchet: SKILL.md 6011 → 6010 / 6011; bootstrap.md 1342 / 1343 (untouched); operations.md 3388 / 3394 (untouched); plugin-development.md 3125 → 3127 / 3137. No ceiling raised or lowered.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 48 commands at head `a8feafb4`. 47 exit 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package's `dist`, and CI runs it. `dispatch-gates --ran` exit 0: 47 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The record is in the project files as `card-31112/s9-gates-a8feafb4.txt`.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` :: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test <3 paths>`: GOVERNED (Tier H).
- Contract review: `dispatch-gates --tier` mandates `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` for `skills/**` (clause ①). The maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-03 waives that build tier for card threads. The skills seat runs the contract review of record at that tier.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no code changed)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (`.changeset/31112-platform-example-blocks.md`, `'@objectstack/skills': patch`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 section is the lane's Chinese summary for the maintainer)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
